description: This script automates testing for subject line preservation in git format-patch, covering various scenarios such as short, long, and multiline subjects, and their handling with different git am options.

methods.name: make_patches
methods.description: Creates patches with specified subject type and message, tests generating patches with different headers and formats.

methods.name: check_subject
methods.description: Applies patches and checks if the subject line is preserved as expected.
